proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hAB h hd hr
  have hin : inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (D -ᵥ A) = 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_comm]; exact (InnerProductGeometry.inner_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two _ _).mpr hr
  have hCA : C -ᵥ A = (B -ᵥ A) + (D -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [h, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  rw [dist_comm A B, dist_comm A D, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V D A] at hd
  have hnn : ‖C -ᵥ A‖ = Real.sqrt 2 * ‖B -ᵥ A‖ := by
    have h1 := norm_add_sq_real (B -ᵥ A) (D -ᵥ A)
    rw [hin, ← hCA, ← hd] at h1
    have h2 : ‖C -ᵥ A‖ ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt 2 * ‖B -ᵥ A‖) ^ 2 := by
      rw [h1, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]; ring
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp h2
  have hne : ‖B -ᵥ A‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (vsub_ne_zero.mpr hAB.symm)
  constructor
  · rw [dist_comm A C, dist_comm A B, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, hnn]
  · unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle InnerProductGeometry.angle
    rw [hnn, hCA, inner_add_right, hin, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, add_zero, ← Real.arccos_cos (x := Real.pi / 4) (by positivity) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]), Real.cos_pi_div_four]
    congr 1
    have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hs2]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), A ≠ B → B -ᵥ A = C -ᵥ D → dist A B = dist A D → EuclideanGeometry.angle D A B = Real.pi / 2 → dist A C = Real.sqrt 2 * dist A B ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi / 4
